initial: D115 saved complete rear-lower handoff, no APPROACH rerun
matched_prefix: recorded600frames plus60zero-commandframes; integral exactly0 through660; both branches must match23 full numeric arrays at600 and660

integral.neutral: no growth; supporting effort kept; opposing error may unwind
integral.reverse: no growth in old direction; opposing error unwinds
integral.antiwindup: bounded accumulator itself; no hidden sum
integral.reason_for_cap: initial ~35mm P error corresponds~105kN;120kN gives a finite diagnostic envelope, not a physical force cap

guards: all original manual hard guards; first failure save and stop; original upper-target projection preserved

acceptance.stop: both neutral phases last15 frames original motion.stopped
acceptance.reverse: negative net actual bucket displacement and <=0.2s latency to velocity below -1mm/s
acceptance.qualification: all criteria together; otherwise report partial improvement or reject, never relax after run

scope: no lift/truck or payload-success qualification; diagnostics not training; per-rock contact decomposition observational only
runtime: serial local RTX4070 cuda:0,1290frames each, about4-6min per process
